description: This file defines a Perl package 'Coocook::Script::Deploy' which extends 'App::DH' and is used for database maintenance scripting within the Coocook project. It sets up database types, schema, and deployment handler configuration.

classes.name: Coocook::Script::Deploy
classes.description: A Perl class for database deployment scripting, extending 'App::DH' with custom schema and deployment handler setup.

methods.name: _build_database
methods.description: Returns an array reference of supported database types: SQLite and PostgreSQL.

methods.name: _build__dh
methods.description: Constructs and returns a new 'Coocook::DeploymentHandler' object configured with schema, force overwrite flag, script directory, database types, and target version.
